original_goal:
[Module: Checkout - Information | TC-011 | Type: Edge/Boundary | Priority: Medium]
Title: Whitespace-only in First Name is treated as empty and blocks submission

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "user": "standard_user"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Checkout – Information form

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter a whitespace-only value (spaces or tabs) in the First Name field
  2. Enter a valid value in the Last Name field
  3. Enter a valid value in the Zip/Postal Code field
  4. Click **Continue**

Expected Result:
  Submission is blocked; an error banner with the exact text "Error: First Name is required" is displayed; the user remains on Checkout – Information

Notes from prior verification:
  Manually verified for completion.
